name: csp_dense
_comment: Dense obstacle field for the CSP module, iterated twice. First attempt (8-10 blocks around the edges) barely changed the joint success rate versus the default map (~56% -> ~33%) because the extra area wasn't placed where the robot-spawn and food-distance constraints actually overlap. This version tiles a 3-column x 4-row grid of blocks across the robot's own spawn band (pixels x:100-700, y:40-258, kept 7px clear of the food-safe box starting at y:280) plus the same outer-ring blocks as before. Measured joint success rate (obstacle-free AND within the 100-300px distance band, over 300k random two-variable draws): ~6.8%, down from ~56% on default -- roughly 8x fewer valid random draws, finally a large enough gap for backtracking-vs-generate-and-test to show a real difference. See TESTING.md for the full iteration story, including the design that looked promising (1.8%) but turned out to have a bug (an obstacle overlapping the food-safe box by a few pixels, invalidating the measurement).
